description:
In the Warathon Marathon Live Stream starting on Friday, Nov 13, 2026 we are committing to playing for either 24-hours straight or until one side is tabled, whichever comes first. https://www.youtube.com/live/Jwo6q6qVAiU?si=eYbrdiT_dPxvrdux

This is a Fundraising initiative for the channel because we have some big plans for 2027!

No Video Editors were harmed in the making of this video.

HIRING
While we do plan to expand many of the positions we are hiring for have a person earmarked for them. We also only hire locally due to the nature of our studio. We are not ready to look at applications as we do not have a dedicated HR department.
